close_reason: All three flaky tests resolved on qzr2-wal-trim: the two distributor tests were removed with the distributor; the olivine 1ms-timeout race was fixed in 06eee2ef (PR #111).
description:
Three distinct test-code races, each failed one recent develop run (product behavior correct in all logs):

1. test/bedrock/control_plane/distributor/server_test.exs:260 — Process.monitor/1 is attached after start_distributor; when the sweep delta is rejected quickly the distributor exits before the monitor attaches, so the DOWN arrives with :noproc instead of :normal (run 29548302754). Telemetry in the mailbox confirms the distributor stopped with reason :normal.

2. test/bedrock/control_plane/distributor/readoption_test.exs:314 — :sys.get_state(distributor) at line 328 races with the distributor stopping normally (the test's expected outcome); get_state exits with :normal (run 29447945622).

3. test/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/genserver_integration_test.exs:654 — GenServer.call(pid, {:info, :kind}, 1) with a 1ms timeout; comment says 'should either succeed or timeout gracefully' but the call is not wrapped in catch_exit, so a timeout on a slow runner crashes the test (run 29548013855).

All three only ever fail on the OTP 27.2 / Elixir 1.17.3 matrix job, likely the slowest. Fixes: (1) capture state/monitor before the race window or accept the noproc/normal pair via a monitor-first helper; (2) drop or guard the get_state on a process expected to die; (3) wrap the 1ms call in catch_exit.

comments.text: Fix pushed as PR #111 (branch fix/bedrock-yp2-flaky-tests): guard DOWN assertions for :noproc monitor-attach races in server_test/readoption_test, drop the racy :sys.get_state in readoption_test, catch the 1ms call timeout in olivine genserver_integration_test. All 44 affected tests pass locally; format+credo clean.

title: Fix three flaky test races failing develop CI on OTP 27.2/Elixir 1.17.3
